title: Command & Conquer 3: Kane's Wrath

engine.name: SAGE 2 (RNA), expansion build
engine.evidence: cnc3ep1.dat imports the same Direct3D 9/DirectInput/DirectSound set as Tiberium Wars; RetailExe/<version>/cnc3ep1.dat is the versioned game binary; CNC3TW/CNC3.exe is a zero-byte placeholder.
engine.notes: Kane's Wrath does not run Tiberium Wars' binary: it has its own product ids and its own data set, so it is profiled separately.

staticAnalysis.method: PE header/import parse plus ASCII string scan of launcher and game binaries
staticAnalysis.limits: Launcher is .bind-wrapped; the game binary is readable. RetailExe also contains older 1.0-1.2 builds and .bak copies, which are deliberately not treated as the build this profile describes.

notes: RetailExe/1.3/cnc3ep1.dat is the newest versioned binary present; the launcher chooses one at runtime, which a measured session must confirm.
